title.romaji: Orenchi ni Kita Onna Kishi to Inakagurashi Surukotoninatta Ken

105582.description: "You're my secretary. I can use you however I want…" "Why do I have to do this?"-----Hina Nakaya works as a secretary and at a business meeting gets harassed by Masaomi Hifumi, the CEO of the client company. After the meeting, Masaomi suddenly kisses Hina. She headbutts him and escapes from him. One day, Hina's mother introduces her fiance and his son, who's going to be Hina's step brother, whom Hina is very surprised to see again...

title.native: ケダモノ暴君お義兄さんと禁断ドS暮らし
title.romaji: Kedamono Boukun no Onii-san to Kindan Do S Kurashi

105583.description: Anna is the lone daughter of a well-to-do family. She's also in love with Takamasa, her educator. Her forbidden crush stings her heart... But then, one day, Takamasa tells Anna that he will be ending his term as her educator.

title.native: その純潔、もっと濡らしていいですか？
title.romaji: Sono Junketsu, Motto Nurashite Ii desu ka?

105586.description: Lighthearted stories of stick figures (until the plot kicks in).

105587.description: Four idiot high school students attending a boy’s school for idiots are on a quest to get girlfriends! For this, they need to better understand the female mind! They somehow make the logical leap that the best way to do so is through doing gay stuff with each other. With BL manga in hand, they start their pleasure investigation!

title.native: どうしてもヤリたくて学園

105588.description: In the middle of the 15th century, Vlad III Draculea succeeded his father. To keep his throne, he must deal with a hostile nobility and a tormented environment, already threatened by his direct neighbors, the Ottoman Empire and the kingdom of Hungary. In a Europe that only knows war, the young prince, son of the dragon, will have to use all means to prevent Wallachia from sinking.

105589.description:
Aoi Yamamoto is 20 years old. Determined to get his first girlfriend, he joined a Nihonshu Club...only to find it chock-full of men. Disappointed, Aoi overindulges, and is taken home by a fellow club member to recover. This club member is also a virgin, even though he's had many girlfriends, and when he shows Aoi why, well...Aoi finds he wants to try it out for himself.

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: Sa taille XL... toujours un bonheur

105591.description:
"No one really knows who you are.''
The place where Alice, who had forgotten everything except the name, woke up was a closed school. The key to knowing the past that we have found among girls who are not searching for the reason why they are here and the rules that should not be associated with the outside world, and special abilities that are unique to themselves. Should I choose ignorance or the truth behind the thorns? A story of a girl who is going for a bright place.

105592.description:
Welcome to the Thundercloud Inn, a curious establishment that opens its doors to the troubled masses, human or otherwise. But to pay for the stay, the equally curious innkeeper takes payment only in the form of one's deepest secrets…Who will come calling today?

(Source: Yen Press)

105593.description: Venus of Milo, Nike of Samothrace, Hammurabi Code, etc ... Occupation "Restauronist" Gilbert who makes contracts with various "antiques" and fights with those who have the will. Human x antique buddy battle !!

title.native: BUDDY ANTIQUE-バディ・アンティーク-

105594.description: Honda, who lived that day while erasing his traces, meets a mysterious transvestite man, Himemiya. Himemiya makes Honda work at a rain fog security company. The face behind the rain fog guard is a spy who sneaks into the truth of a person and reveals the truth. It was human intelligence. A honey trap battle action full of laughter and sadness presented by Matsuri of "Bakemono no Yoru Tsuzukushi"!

105597.description:
A series of strange events led to being toyed around popular idols!? The sparkling double Idol lifestyle starts now!

Notes:
- Includes one extra chapter.
- Includes the one-shot "Anata wa Mou, Dareka no Mono (アナタはもう、誰かのモノ)".
- Includes the one-shot "Kare to Watashi no Koisuru Jikenbo (彼と私の恋する事件簿)"; Sho-Comi 2017 #8
synonyms: Anata wa Mou, Dareka no Mono
Kare to Watashi no Koisuru Jikenbo

title.native: アイドルさまのお気に入り!?

105598.description:
A freak virus mutation occurred by chance in an old lady's body. Now, 10 years later, the world is enveloped with a fear of zombies!! Now that this new zombie "species" has been born, who will be the one to bear the accursed "will" of being the god of the zombie world?

The Pandemic Panic starts now!!!

105599.description:
Eight years ago, our parents remarried and we became brothers.

Haruto is six years older than me. We’re not related by blood, but he treats me kindly and takes care of me as if I were his real brother. Because of this, I started harboring this desire to monopolize him…. I don’t want him to find out about these dirty feelings! Although I live alone now that I started university, my brother found a way to come after me….!?

title.native: 兄貴と一緒じゃ眠れない

105600.description:
"I've got absolutely no interest in your nakedness." Coming from the previously so kind and gentle manager, those are the cold words that won't leave her head. In order to get over her one-sided crush, Yuu travels by herself to stay at a gorgeous hotel she found. After arriving at the bus stop, she is greeted by the gorgeous manager who says he has come to pick her up and bring her to the hotel. She is so taken in by his beauty, that she doesn't hear a word of the explanation of the hotels services and signs the contract with no cares at all. That night, the staff member in charge of her room barges in and pushes her down on the bed, telling her that she will fall in love with him. He lays kisses upon her collarbone, her chest… and as his tongue goes lower and lower on her body she begins to feel things that she's never felt before and that set her body on fire.

Serialized digitally by Mobile Media Research in 2015 as 間違えて、ドＳ支配人に買われました ～裏ドレイ契約の甘い罠～ (Machigaete, Do S Shihainin ni Kawaremashita ~ Ura Dorei Keiyaku No Amai Wana ~). Published in tankoubon by Oakla Shuppan in 2016 as 野獣執事のイケナイ躾け (Yajuu Shitsuji no Ikenai Shitsuke).

title.romaji: Machigaete, Do S Shihainin ni Kawaremashita: Ura Dorei Keiyaku No Amai Wana

105601.description: A boy becomes the dog of a high school girl.

105602.description:
Viola is the daughter of a destitute earl from a famine-stricken kingdom. Cersis is the rich, handsome and eligible duke of Rosia. He asks for her hand in marriage, but only as his "contract wife"! Instead of undying affection, he promises her a comfortable life with the freedom to do as she pleases - including having a boyfriend! Read on and watch her embrace life as a "pretend wife"! We are happy to finally be able to present this comedy manga of a "contract marriage" between a destitute earl's independent daughter and her handsome duke husband and his nomadic girlfriend!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 誰可以說明一下現在是什麼狀況啊！～從契約開始的婚禮～

title.english: The Duchess Of Rosia -A Contract Marriage? How Did This Happen!?-
title.native: 誰かこの状況を説明してください！ ～契約から始まるウェディング～
title.romaji: Dareka Kono Joukyou wo Setsumei Shite Kudasai!: Keiyaku kara Hajimaru Wedding

105603.description:
A 5 million debt suddenly befalls on cash-strapped student, Kamijou Yuuki. It’s because of his father that he went through many hardships, and he goes to drink in desperation but…When he comes to, he’s on a bed full of ￥10,000 bills and a half naked man――?! After waking up, the man even says “I’ll give you the money”. Confused, Yuuki escapes and goes home, but he re-encounters the mysterious man, Nao. “I’ll give you the money, so let’s have sex. Think of it as physical labor.” Nao says, but what does Yuuki do…?

(Source: michiruzuki)

105604.description:
1-2: Furete, Aishite, Dakishimete
Seno the bartender has been assaulted and has suffered a trauma which made him afraid of human touch. Due to that, he has been unable to find a proper lover so he has given up. One night, he is confessed to by a regular customer named Hakamada and Seno turns him down as usual, but Hakamada doesn't give up and he confesses his sincere feelings again. Seno reconsiders and opens up about his trauma, to which Hakamada says "That means if you understand that you shouldn't be afraid of me it will be fine, right?" and hugs Seno to help him overcome his fear. After this, Hakamada continues to hug Seno every day...!?
3-4: A continuation of Please Hold Me Tenderly from Ijiwaru Shinai de Dakishimete.
5: Going Lovers
The relationship between a popular idol and a band member.

title.native: 触れて、愛して、抱きしめて

105605.description:
1. Shishunki Sex (思春期セックス); Comic Shingeki 2018-04
2-4. Kyou, Watashinchi Shuugou ne! (今日、私ん家集合ね!); Comic Shingeki 2017-07, 09, 2018-02
5. Nurunuru DeliHeal (ぬるぬるデリヘル); Comic Shingeki 2017-04
6. Saiminjutsu ni Kakerarete (催眠術にかけられて); Comic Shingeki 2016-08
7. Nantai Shoujo (軟体少女); Comic Shingeki 2016-12
8. After Nantai Shoujo (after軟体少女); kakioroshi

105609.description: A tale of a girl who can see "wolves."

105610.description: The story depicts the daily life of Noa, a high school girl with a unique personality who hangs out with the popular girls, along with her friends in the same group, Chitose and Konari.

105611.description:
The Draft... The gateway every pro baseball player has to pass through. Behind the scenes are the scouts who comb through high school, college, corporate, and independent leagues, searching for hidden talents and sending future stars to the pro leagues. Aura Gohara, a scout with an exceptional "Eye" for talent. Who will be the next player he discovers?!

The battle begins to land the top prospect of the year - the Draft King!!!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

105612.description:
People who lived for a short time and tried to leave, but ended up sitting in temporary shelters called ‘gosiwons’. 'Seongho' is a job seeker who lives in the same situation as the goshiwon residents, but still thinks he is different from them. If you put your mind to it, you can escape this place like Tails in no time! No, wouldn't it be better if the world were destroyed? A zombie appears in the next room, and screams of biting and biting can be heard from outside. I, no, we have to survive.
(Namu, translated)

105613.description:
The manga follows a coffee food truck shop, where the barista makes an individual cup for each customer. The coffee brewed conscientiously, sincerely, and wholeheartedly helps customers unwind.

(Source: Anime News Network)

105614.description:
The story centers on Nagi Ooshima, a girl who is too conscious of everyone's mood and can't really get close to anyone. One day, she collapses from hyperventilation. After talking to her ex-boyfriend, she quits work, moves, and runs away from everything to start anew.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Notes:
- Won the 65th Shogakukan Manga Award for Best Shoujo Manga in 2019.
- Nominated to the 23rd Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.

title.native: 魔法主婦マジカルミュー

105621.description: A collection of six stories published in Feel Young between 2007 and 2008.

105622.description:
Follow Ebizou, a self-proclaimed genius, in his attempts to murder the old pawn-broker lady who called him a retard.

This manga is a parody of Fyodor Dostoyevsky's novel of the same name.

105623.description:
"I'm the God of Death. Just now your death was decided. But I'll do you the favor of extending your life for three days," said a young girl wearing a miniskirt and a white T-shirt. 

This is the story of a God of Death and an impure soul...

title.native: ベイビー、グッドモーニング

105624.description:
The story of the relationship between a boy escaping the heat Tokyo by staying in a rural home to study for his exams, and the young girl that lives there.

Note:
- It has a live-action AV adaptation: MUDR-182 (2022/3/15)

105627.description:
Mari, a college student, wakes up and finds herself on a battlefield. Looking around in confusion, she sees many knights in Western-style armor, and they call out, “Her Majesty the Queen,” to her. Apparently, Mari’s “army” is in the midst of a battle, and they are badly outnumbered. Believing it to be a mere dream, she devises a plan to win the fight, but to her surprise…she is really in the body of a queen! In this miracle fantasy, an ordinary college girl struggles as a “queen” in a different world!

(Source: Alpha Manga)

title.english: The Life Trajectory of an Evil Queen

105628.description:
Wolves and foxes have been living with humans to breed. There's a rule that they cannot hang out or fall in love with each other since they are rivals when it comes to breeding. But wolf Han Sirang and fox Kim Ho are attracted to each other and break that rule by secretly continuing their dangerous relationship...

Winner of the 5th MrBlue Comic Contest

105629.description: In near future, Humanity discovered incredible ore with unlimited energy, 「Iliosdaite」. In ten years since its discovery that core energy became an alternate fuel supporting the whole world. But, a lot of Monsters and evil organizations were eager to get their hands on Iliosdaite. That's when a Hero rose up to protect the Peace. His name was..... Love Fighter Shuravan.

synonyms: Theme of the Water & Biscuit War Around the Convenience Store

title.native: ウォーター&ビスケットのテーマ

105632.description:
Yomizuka Junior High School, which is located in a country town, has a strange club called the Mystery Inspection Club.

The club has two members. Toramaru, who is entangled in the Chuunibyou syndrome, and the more reliable Miko. The club's activites started with a small curiosity, but grew to involve many people...!?

A little horror eavesdropping youth story.

105633.description:
It is said that a shrine maiden once offered her chastity to the dog spirit in return for his protection for ten generations... I am the descendant of that shrine maiden. But, lately, some eerie black shadows have been stalking me. Just when I'm about to get hit by a speeding train, this mysteriously powerful, handsome guy saves me. He says he's come to exchange vows, and then suddenly starts kissing me! I should shake him off, but I just can't resist his advances!!
(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Inugami-sama to Shojo Miko no Koi

title.english: The Dog Spirit and the Shrine Maiden
title.native: 狗神様と処女巫女の恋
title.romaji: Inugami-sama to Shoujo Miko no Koi

105634.description:
"Hey, what are you licking?!" 
As the tongue flicks its way across me, my body responds! Takanashi Yui was born into a family that people have an aversion to due to a curse that makes them all die early deaths. Then, one day, Yui's suddenly attacked by a monster!! Right at the last minute, a mysterious, beautiful boy saves her and suddenly gives her a deep kiss, which completely freezes her up. Then, ears and a tail sprout from his body?! In order to use his strange powers to save Yui from the monsters, he needs energy from her body, and assaults her with sexy touches... What in the world's going to happen?!

title.english: LOVE PRISON: The Sadistic Knight and the Indecent Vow
title.native: 恋獄奇憚 ～S系騎士と淫蜜の誓い～
title.romaji: Rengoku Kitan: S-kei Kishi to Inmitsu no Chikai

105635.description:
Sumire has been assigned to a publishing company as a novice hair and make-up artist. On her first day, she suddenly witnesses a man and woman in the act! Moreover, the man who looked so familiar is Atsuki, a hugely popular model. Knowing she saw him, Atsuki locks his sights on her. He's overbearing and a narcissist, and Sumire think nothing of him at first, but... Huh? He's doing it with the Editor-in-Chief right now!? He calls out to her... "You should come here, too, Sumire!"

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Dripping from His Fingertips! -How the Selfish Prince Hunts-
title.native: アイツの指で濡れちゃう！～ワガママ王子の狩りの美学～
title.romaji: Aitsu no Yubi de Nurechau!: Wagamama Ouji no Kari no Bigaku

105636.description:
Rika Niikura, 28, is currently hiding the fact that she has feelings for the young company president Satoshi Kojima. The two of them were friends as kids and were reunited by chance at Satoshi's company, but he doesn't seem to remember... Rika, on the other hand, still thinks of him as her first love. Everyone's getting married and having kids, and she knows she's falling behind, but...! With all that on her mind, a young yet dependable new employee, Takeshi Kiryuu, joins the team. Rika is charged with training him. She realizes that the gentle boy will be an asset, but then she lets her guard down...! She receives a passionate booty-call on the night after they just met, and he asks to be her pet!! What on Earth does that mean!?
(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The New Guy Is Looking at Me Like He Wants to Be My Pet!
title.native: 後輩くんがペットになりたそうにこっちを見ている！
title.romaji: Kouhai-Kun ga Pet ni Naritasou ni Kocchi wo Miteiru!

105637.description:
Working at the same company, the cool salesman Hazuki and project coordinator Mina are in the midst of a secret love affair. Due to the company's strict policy against office romance, if they are caught they will be forced apart. Even so, Hazuki has a sadistic side that knows no bounds and loves to cause mischief. Mischief that involves intense inter-office relations...

(Source: Renta!)

Kimochi Yokute Koe mo Denai?: Ura Kareshi no Zeitaku na Shitsukekata
気持ちよくて声も出ない？ ～ナイショの社内恋愛、発覚!? 編～
Kimochi Yokute Koe mo Denai?: Naisho no Shanai Renai, Hakkaku!? Hen

105638.description:
"If he makes love to me so passionately, I'll die from pleasure overload...!" Guess what, it actually happened, and now I'm stuck in limbo!! The only way for me to come back to life is to sleep with a bunch of guys and find my true prince! It's either be pleasured, or die... And so begins this sweet-yet-enticing love game...!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Fallen Princess from Heaven -Find Pleasure, Die, or Fall in Love-
title.native: 堕天姫～イクか死ぬか恋するか～
title.romaji: Datenhime: Iku ga Shinu ka Koisuru ka

105639.description:
Because of some technicality, Toko ends up transferring to all-boy school. She gets bullied because of her geeky appearances, but the two handsomest students at the school help her out. They give Toko a makeover so she is becoming prettier and prettier, but their makeover plan is not just to change her appearances but also her body...They caress Toko's body and make her body so sensitive...

(Source: Manga Reborn)
synonyms: Omae no Shojo wo Produce by Ookami Danshi & Hyou Prince

title.native: お前の処女をプロデュース by オオカミ男子&豹プリンス
title.romaji: Omae no Shoujo o Produce by Ookami Danshi & Hyou Prince

105640.description:
Ash meets the Mythical Pokémon Volcanion when it crashes down from the sky, creating a cloud of dust - an a mysterious force binds the two of them together! Volcanion despises humans and tries to get away, but it's forced to drag Ash along as it continues its rescue mission. They arrive in a city of cogs and gears, where a corrupt minister has stolen the ultimate invention: the Artificial Pokémon Magearna, created 500 years ago. He plans to use its mysterious power to take control of this mechanical kingdom! Can Ash and Volcanion work together to rescue Magearna? One of the greatest battles in Pokémon history is about to unfold!

(Source: VIZ Media)

title.english: Pokémon the Movie: Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel
title.native: ポケットモンスター XY & Z ボルケニオンと機巧のマギアナ
title.romaji: Pocket Monsters XY & Z: Volcanion to Karakuri no Magearna

105641.description:
Serialisation of the original Twitter comic!

Kaede Komura has a huge crush on his seat partner, Mie-san. She, however, has terrible eyesight, and tends to either forget or break her glasses! Komura-kun offers her a helping hand, and as they grow closer, their feelings for each other grow too.

(Source: Comikey)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

Cô bạn tôi thầm thích lại quên mang kính rồi

title.native: 好きな子がめがねを忘れた
title.romaji: Suki na Ko ga Megane wo Wasureta

105642.description:
A high school girls love triangle drama.

Includes 3 bonus chapters.

105645.description: A gag comedy about the demonic salesman of a book publisher.

105646.description: The story of a medical team and their confrontations with cases of child abuse.

105647.description: One day, Akira Isomori, an ordinary office worker who lives with his novelist wife, Sonoko, suddenly finds himself on the verge of death. He manages to survive, but his body is transformed into a woman due to a medical phenomena known as  "isomerization".

105648.description: A boy named Shi Shan along with his little sister were offered as sacrifice to a demon that has been haunting their village. They were rescued by a martial artist who exorcise demons. He took the siblings in as his disciples and taught them the art of cultivation and about the demons that dwell in this world.

105649.description: One day Jina, a 24-year-old woman, realizes that she has a peculiar constitution that turns into a man's body at midnight. Forced to change to a job without overtime, Jina starts working at a law firm as an office clerk. An unfortunate chain of events leads to her handsome playboy lawyer boss witnessing the moment when she transforms into a man...?!

105651.description:
It’s been five years since strange dungeons opened up around the Earth, spilling monsters into our world. Average citizens everywhere have risen to the challenge to become adventurers, fighting these fantasy creatures and clearing out dungeons as best they can. Among them is Karaboshi Haruki, a 27-year-old rookie overlooked by everyone and…less than successful at beating monsters and finding treasure. Unsure how he can compete with much more powerful adventurers, an opportunity is dropped into his lap–a dungeon suddenly appears right beneath his home! Could this be a place for him to train? Even better, he discovers a Skill Board that allows him to level up faster! The dungeon-diving adventures Haruki has always dreamed of are just getting started.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Let’s be an Adventurer! ~Defeating Dungeons with a Skill Board~

title.english: CALL TO ADVENTURE! Defeating Dungeons with a Skill Board
title.native: 冒険家になろう! ~スキルボードでダンジョン攻略~
title.romaji: Boukenka ni Narou!: Skill Board de Dungeon Kouryaku

105652.description:
Serialization of the web novel with the same name.

It’s been five years since strange dungeons opened up around the Earth, spilling monsters into our world. Average citizens everywhere have risen to the challenge to become adventurers, fighting these fantasy creatures and clearing out dungeons as best they can. Among them is Karaboshi Haruki, a 27-year-old rookie overlooked by everyone and…less than successful at beating monsters and finding treasure. Unsure how he can compete with much more powerful adventurers, an opportunity is dropped into his lap–a dungeon suddenly appears right beneath his home! Could this be a place for him to train? Even better, he discovers a Skill Board that allows him to level up faster! The dungeon-diving adventures Haruki has always dreamed of are just getting started.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

A virgin boy stands at the rooftop of the school after his girlfriend got stolen, intending to both commit suicide and get his revenge by falling on the new couple who wronged him. Casually appearing next to him was a female teacher, seemingly unmoved by his act.

Instead he got himself into a thrilling journey where kendo masters, detective sisters, young misses of rich families entangled with him. Yuwen Jun was stunned while facing so many unexpected incidents: "I just came to get married..."

105658.description:
A single teenage girl journeys through the crumbling ruins of civilization—the last human on Earth, exploring the concrete jungle that has outlived mankind. Keeping her company is woman’s best friend—the ever-adorable and quick-witted Shiba Inu Haru, who is ready to stick with her through thick and thin! With such a pleasant conversation partner to keep the postapocalyptic doldrums at bay, the end of the world might not be so bad after all!

Takuya and Miki return to their hometown for a friend's wedding anniversary, but as they arrive, Takuya receives a call from their friends, whom they were unable to contact through the whole trip. Due to bad reception, they can't understand what's been said, but only the words "help" and "Hijuumura" are clearly heard. Since the police isn't of any help, Takuya and Miki leave to rescue their friends, but soon find out that that was place not meant to be entered...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Minako Nishiwaki's life is a constant struggle for money since her mother is addicted to gambling and regularly incurs large amounts of debt. To pay off the latest debt, Minako accepts a position as a live-in tutor to Naoki, the rebellious son of a rich family. He is in his last year of high school and has terrible grades, but if she can successfully get him into university, the family will pay her enough to take care of the debt.
However, it seems Naoki requires some... special motivation.

As Shin Youngwoo has had an unfortunate life and is now stuck carrying bricks on construction sites. He even had to do labor in the VR game, Satisfy!

However, luck would soon enter his hopeless life. His character, ‘Grid’, would discover the Northern End Cave for a quest, and in that place, he would find ‘Pagma’s Rare Book’ and become a legendary class player…

105666.description: Mao is 14 years old and the daughter of a legendary warrior and top martial artist. A child of the elite, she longs to be the cutest of witches, but Mao is a little on the impulsive side and not actually that smart. Although she is quite strong, her magic power is zero and her life is a series of destruction... followed by regret…

College girl Kawada Rika gets roped into going to a mixer where she meets an older girl named Suda Natsuko and they are immediately enamored with each other.

It was supposed to be a secret fantasy... but then the student council president's sister, Nika, picked up the notebook...!? Natsuki Nanahoshi is a junior high school student with an unlikely secret, who is scouted by a… stuffed animal? This… thing tells Natsuki that keeping his secret for so long has given him magical powers, and then forces him to become a Magical Boy!

Enjoy this "forbidden" magic fantasy filled with sorcery, boys, and kissing!

synonyms: Ten Thousand Paths to Becoming a God

Mimi has become the manager of Okamiso in place of her late grandfather. It was formerly a place of memories where her first boyfriend, Toma, had lived. But the new tenant is a super beast who gets down and dirty with any girl he invites over! Since the day he pounced on her, he's made Mimi's inexperienced and innocent body dripping wet...

I backhand giving you a scheme, sweeping the invincible hand in the immortal world, just ask is there anyone else? Fronting is like the wind; always by my side! The front road is long; and only fronting may be my friend! Life and death are bearish; !
"Young people, when I started the routine, you are still wearing open pants!"
Xu Que is on the road of scheming, not every day, or on the way to the scheme!

(Source: WebNovel)

105675.description:
Ayano, an elementary school teacher in her thirties, stops by a bar one day and meets another woman named Akari. Sparks fly as the two chat, and before the night is over, Ayano even goes in for a kiss. Akari is intrigued but confused...especially when she discovers that Ayano has a husband! Both Ayano and Akari are about to find out that love doesn’t get any easier, even as you grow older.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

105676.description:
The youngster, Jiang Yinian, became acquaintances with Mu Chen, Lin Dong, and Xiao Yan's descendants on the Spirit Road's Trial, and also stole someone's heart, too. In the process of the trials he realized that he had connections to the Fiend Clan that had been sealed in the Prison Realm, and so, the story begins...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

105677.description:
Originally, I just wanted to live like an ordinary girl. What the hell is going on with the Ghost King? Why should I take the responsibility for our one night stand, which was totally accidental. Jesus! The King: Stop complaining. It was all your fault! Poor Me: Yes, Ghost King! That's fine... Boohoo...

(Source: Webcomics App)

105678.description:
What lies in worlds beyond our own? Is it a bright light and then… nothingness? Or is it another land populated with gorgeous beauty and eldritch horror beyond our recognition? General Hwee-un falls in battle, leaving behind his unspoken love and a life unlived and awakens in a… forest? Malevolent spirits and demons vie for his life until a handsome goblin whisks him away to the Goblin Village and into the court of the Goblin King. Whatever life may exist in the beyond, death is only the beginning.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 儚げに〜とある妖が棲む国の話〜

105679.description:
When Satoshi oversleeps on his 10th birthday, he ends up with a stubborn Pikachu instead of the first partner Pokémon he wanted! But after a rocky start, Satoshi and Pikachu become close friends and true partners - and when they catch a rare glimpse of the Legendary Pokémon Ho-Oh in flight, they make plants to seek it out together. Trainers Makoto and Souji join Satoshi on his journey, and along the way, they meet the mysterious Mythical Pokémon Marshadow. When they near their goal, an arrogant Trainer named Cross stands in their way. Can Satoshi and Pikachu defeat him and reach Ho-Oh as they promised, or will their journey end here?

(Source: VIZ Media)

When their father passed away, too, the kids were taken in by their rich relatives the Nanami clan. 105688.description:
No matter how much time we spend together, I’ll never become special to you.

Childhood best friends. Two halves of a whole. The cool, smart one who’s good at almost everything, and his average, dorky friend who struggles to do anything right­—Yamato and Kakeru. Always by the other’s side, but not together in the way they truly want to be. No matter how hard they try, their hearts cannot reach each other…

(Source: Yen Press)

The story follows four ex-convicts who met in prison. Upon release, they have since moved to the capital city of Badon to open a high-class tobacco shop.

105690.description:
The Human Empire fell to ruin, leaving behind a dystopia controlled by the current Machinery Empire. In this wasteland where human life is deemed worthless, a wandering boy meets a princess in hiding.

When tragedy occurs, the fallen rise, and a journey begins. Thus begins the story of two children and their fight to restore hope for humanity

105691.description:
During his youth, Usawa Itsuki often took care of Kameyama Yui, Itsuki's neighbor and several years his junior. When she was in elementary school, Yui declared she would become Itsuki's bride. Years pass, and when they meet again, Itsuki turns out to be a teacher at Yui's high school. Will their relationship develop into something more than just neighbors?

Note: Originally published as a doujin, later sold as ebook chapters by Otometika Shuppan from July 13, 2018 to October 19, 2018.

105692.description:
16-year-old Nanakusa is spending his mundane life on "Stairway Island" where he found himself "discarded" along with 2000 other people, all missing the memories of the time just before they arrived there. The name of the island originates from the long stairway running through the island and extending up to the summit of the mountain where the witch who rules the island is said to live. The only way to leave the island is by finding what was lost. Yet Nanakusa doesn't wish to leave this stagnant island. He enjoys his life there.

That is until Manabe Yuu, his childhood friend appears in front of him, and turns his new life upside-down. Why did Manabe Yuu, the world's most optimistic person, get discarded, and who is the witch behind all these mysterious occurrences? Follow Nanakusa and Manabe as they uncover the true nature of Stairway Island.

My unforgettable man for the rest of my life.

Bambi is a human being that can "transform into a bear" when angry. When he was in elementary school, he kept himself from transforming after he knew the secret of the beast species. He met Ookuma who was the reason for his first time turning into a bear! Tormented by Ookuma, Bambi gets angry or sad ... the emotions he was suppressing were overflowing.

"I hate you!"

Although he thought that ... he saw the appearance of Ookuma, who was laughing with a broken heart and Bambi's emotions become a figure of a bear! A man who does not dress well × Tsundere Beastman.

105695.description:
Cerberus—the guard dog of the underworld—is a clumsy puppy who can’t do his job. Although Cerberus is constantly causing trouble for his master, Hades, he is always forgiven for being just so darn cute. So goes this wonderfully fluffy tale of life in the underworld. This heartwarming full-color comic is a must-see for all the dog-lovers out there!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

105696.description: What is it that the detective encounters when investigating a hot spring town that has seen better days...? A curious story begins when he encounters a mysterious exotic dancer...

One day, up-and-coming young photographer Franz Schumann makes a fateful encounter. He won't tell the whole story of where he's from, and Franz, wanting to keep the mysterious Jay as his exclusive model, as time passes, begins to fall in love with him...

Keisuke is down with a bad cold and lost his voice became unable to talk to to Ryou. For the first time, together in a quiet room, Ryou realized how important the words that Keisuke regularly says to him are. And that's the words of sweet love.

105701.description:
Aizawa Haruki, 16 years old, is in his 2nd year of high school, and likes to live efficiently. One day during summer vacation, a girl, Aizawa Himari, suddenly appears, calling him 'Onii-chan' and claiming that she's his little sister. As it turns out, Haruki's father recently remarried, and his new wife brought a daughter with her. However, since both of their parents are overseas, it'll only be the two of them living under the same roof. And for some reason, Himari seems very obstinate about spending as much time with Haruki as she can.

(Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)

105702.description:
The story of a spirit detective and his high school girl assistant.

Restarted in Monthly Comic Zenon 2019/1 with an updated title.

105704.description:
There's more than one Grim Reaper, but they all share the same job: to watch over people and eventually escort their souls to the afterlife. In extraordinary circumstances, a Reaper can give a soul an extra 30 minutes and 30 seconds of life to resolve something left unfinished, but it's only meant to be used under exceptional circumstances. Join one Reaper who cares too much for his souls to allow them to die without one last chance at life.

(Source: Mangamo)

Note: Based on the story 'Thirty And a Half Minutes' by Snippy MJ, winner of the Grand Prix from the Silent Manga Audition.

Shuko Kodakamine is strong—too strong, by the standards of some. She hopes to make a good high school debut, but that plan goes up in smoke almost immediately when she injures the attractive, charismatic Serizawa-kun...and later suplexes him, to boot! But when Serizawa-kun finds himself in hot water with a jealous boyfriend, it's Shuko who comes to his aid...and he comes up with a ridiculous proposition: If Shuko becomes his bodyguard, he'll make her the most important girl in his world!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Her father has entrusted his capable subordinate, Miyashita-san, to look after Misaki! But while living together with him, she started to notice her heart racing more for the slightly ditzy and very kind Miyashita-san... A rich lady x capable subordinate's 24-hour heart-racing love!! 105708.description:
Includes 4 stories about love with various types of childhood friends and an extra.

1. Kiss wa Suit no Mama de (キスはスーツのままで)
A love story between quiet high school girl Sayuri and her 6 years older childhood friend Nana-chan.

2. Houkago to Koisuru Hitomi (放課後と恋する瞳)
The story of childhood friends Haruka, the ace of the archery club, and Shihoko, his biggest supporter, slowly finding each other.

3. Amayakasanaide, Hinata-kun (甘やかさないで、陽向くん)
A love story about the reliable high school third year Aki who gets confessed to by her two years younger puppy-dog childhood friend Hinata.

4. Hiro-kun ga Sensei (ヒロくんが先生)
A love story of high school girl Nao, who's childhood crush Hiro suddenly becomes an assistant teacher at her school.

105711.description:
Hazuki is honest, awkward and a member of the product planning department. Watanabe has the top business performance transfers into his department. Hazuki held animostity towards Watanabe thinking, he is completely different from me and he is attractive with a good personality. But ever since Watanabe invited Hazuki out to eat on the weekend, Hazuki goes to Watanabe's house to eat hot pot and the private time that they spend together becomes fun. But, Hazuki learns about Watanabe's secret and the relationship between the two starts to change...?

(Source: Yaoi Desire Revolution)

105712.description:
A man is entwined and captured by a glamorous yet bizarre, deep-seated terror.

The gears of a young man with a promising future go a little out of order when he meets a certain woman. The genius Youko Kondo vividly visualizes the decadent ghost stories recorded in the masterpiece collection of ghost stories Kurameshu by Koutarou Tanaka, the master of ghost story literature.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

105713.description:
Asuma Sudou has always been a proud pervert, but he's sworn to give that up to chase the girl of his dreams. Having received a special invitation to enter the same all-girls school as her, he's planning to live his romantic youth to the fullest. But those plans are cut short when it turns out the school is a front for a secret organization dedicated to battling kaijin-monsters created when people succumb to their murderous impulses! The girls of the school fight using the relics of defeated kaijin, but when the bloodthirsty instincts sealed within threaten to overwhelm them, Asuma is the only one who can bring them back to their senses!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: 棄老島百鬼 キロートーヒャッキ

105716.description: In the Tranquil Sun province of the empire, there exists an unremarkable lordship known as Xue Ying Territory! This is the home of the Dong Bo clan, the clan of our hero Xue Ying! His father, a commoner turned noble; his mother, a noble who abandoned her clan for love, and his brother, an innocent toddler. But peace cannot last forever, Xue Ying’s peaceful life is shattered, and the only way to reclaim it is through power!

105717.description:
Set up and killed by his best buddy, a top-notch swordsman wakes up finding himself turned back into his teenage self.
Restarting again from the weakling bullied by all, he is determined to seek revenge and cherish the girl who once sacrificed her life for him.

(Source: Mangatoon)

Although, it seems as luck isn’t on his side as he travels in search of ‘The Three Sacred Tools of Avalon’ to try and retrieve his memories...

There was a "battle" a year ago. A contagious disease that suddenly hit a rural area? They will use that ability to fight the variants who appeared at the same time with this disaster.

Just having it is happy. Just that happy. Dreaming about Misa-chan day by day is happy.

Is this happiness?

105723.description:
There's no such thing as too much preparation!

The fate of the S-ranked world Gaeabrande rests with the novice goddess Ristarte. As she thumbs through the piles of duller-than-dull résumés for potential Heroes to summon, she hits the jackpot with Seiya Ryuuguuin, whose stats are so high for a level-1 Hero that he's practically cheating! (He's also pretty easy on the eyes.) But there's a catch. Seiya is cautious to a fault. If he goes to a weapons and armor shop, he asks for three sets of armor: one to wear, a spare, and a spare for the spare. Just in case. He always buys ridiculous amounts of supplies, trains like he's racing to max level, and won't hesitate to use his strongest skills even on a simple slime. With a Hero like Seiya on the job, which will run out first-the Demon Lord's forces or Ristarte's sanity...?

(Source: Yen Press)

105735.description:
Yuu and Mami are a young couple who decide to commit murder-suicide together. As the muddle-headed Mami struggles on a method, a bleeding Yuu resolves to try and wheedle his way out of their vow. Will either of them succeed?

(Source: Anime-Planet)

105736.description: Due to some circumstances, short glasses school boy Kamoshida is sharing a room with a tall, violent female classmate of his. He fell in love with her and stops at nothing to try and get into her panties.

105737.description: A comic essay about the admiration for women who are alone.

105739.description:
1000 years ago, a war between humans and space witches ravaged the stars, destroying countless planets and taking even more lives. Eventually, the humans captured the most powerful witch and imprisoned her as a war criminal under the treaty.

The castle where the Magic Lord is sealed away is watched over by a village where everyone has developed weak magical powers—everyone but Mugi, that is. Determined to prove that he doesn't need magic, Mugi accidentally flies into the monster-infested forest surrounding the castle and is saved by a girl that he has never seen before...
synonyms: The Witch at the End of the World

title.native: 世界の終わりの魔法使い

105740.description:
Dien Bien Phu - TRUE END brings a final conclusion to the series of Dien Bien Phu.

The story is set at the Vietnam War and depicts the love between a young photographer in the military and a young girl who fights for the Viet Cong. Developments rooted in historical reality and sweet touches coexist on the page, vividly depicting the brutality of war.

Note: Jury selection at the 2019 Japan Media Arts Festival.

魔法なんて信じない。でも君は信じる。

All Those Moments Will Be Lost in Time

105747.description:
An unhappy girl who engages in self-harm, a woman ostracized by society, and an old woman looking to live out her twilight years in peace–what could three such different people have in common? That’s what grade schooler Nanoka Koyanagi is trying to find out. Assigned by her teacher to define what “happiness” means to her, Nanoka tries to find her place in the world by exploring her relationships with these three strangers, and through them, comes to know herself.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: また、同じ夢を見ていた

105748.description:
An ordinary run-of-the-mill guy named Takase starts working in the Sales Department of a certain Real Estate agency, and his senpai at this job, Komai, looks more like a middle school girl than an actual adult due to her height and incredible cuteness! As they grow closer together, how will they deal with this unusual situation?

Note: Includes two extras.
synonyms: My Short Senpai Is Way Too Cute

title.native: ちっちゃい先輩が可愛すぎる。
麒麟は一途に恋をする
title.romaji: Kirin wa Ichizu ni Koi wo Suru

105751.description:
A young Tetsuou watched a performance by Giovanni Bazonni and was inspired to become a master cellist. But he knows that living as he is in an out-of-the-way Japanese island means his musical aspirations are unlikely to be realised.

One day, a boy named Ikumi comes to stay at Tetsuou's place. Ikumi is the sole survivor of an accident at sea, wherein he saved himself by swimming out to Tetsuou's island.

But he makes a surprising claim: he says he found his way to safety by following the sound of beautiful cello music, and is convinced that the player was Tetsuou.

105752.description: In college, Miya had a crush on her upperclassman, Inou. To her shock, Inou asks her out one day and the two start living together! Miya feels like she’s in a dream, but she wants to further their relationship. Then one day, Miya takes a look at a package Inou received, and inside is a sexy bra…!

105753.description: 27-year old part-timer Saeko Ihara finds herself infatuated with her 19-year old, boyish coworker, Mamoru Take, despite the fact that she's 8 years older and they're both girls. Because of this, she tries to ignore her feelings, but there's one problem - Take loves being physically affectionate!
synonyms: Fell in love with a girl 8 years younger

title.romaji: 8-Sai Toshishita no Dousei no Ko ni Koishita

105754.description:
It was something that could've happened to anyone... A somewhat mysterious story... In a perfectly ordinary city, a mysterious event unexpectedly begins. Together at night, sneaking into the school building, "slightly" different from usual, that's the story of this world.

(Source: Getchu)

105755.description: Having graduated from the prestigious Witchcraft Institute at the top of his class, no job is out of reach for William Glenford. But William dreams of only one thing: adventures.

105762.description:
Ryuugasaki Kou is as fat as a meatball, and has a huge crush on his high school senpai, Hiiragi Chiaki, who calls him “Oniku-chan”. On Chiaki’s graduation day, Kou finally works up the courage to… not quite ask him out, but is horribly rejected!

After working to lose all of his weight, Kou is now new and improved, but when he finally runs into Chiaki, he discovers that Chiaki is and always has been a chubby chaser?!

Now they’re finally dating, but Chiaki is asking him to fatten up again, and Chiaki’s ex-boyfriend has also entered the mix…!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

105763.description:
I'm not a woman, man, human, nor animal.
I am me, and—I'm only here to protect.
A completely new work set in the same universe as Reimei no Arcana.

105764.description:
Japan's favorite child celebrity, Ena Fujie is busy with her entertainment gig! Except for Tashiro, Ena's clumsy manager, the adults around her have not realized that behind her cute and captivating performance, she is a very ambitious kid that calculates every move to win everyone's heart! What kind of shenanigans will she pull out today?

(Source: Torico)

105765.description: The Immortals arrived 500 years ago. They were originally celebrated, even worshipped, but as they began to use humanity for their own ends they became reviled. Now, an immortal girl hunts for her own kind in their deep lairs to bring about the end of their reign of terror.

title.native: マジョンナ 三家本礼 Extra Works

105768.description: The story is about a man whose compulsive tendencies make it impossible for him to keep a job and a young girl who skips school and loves insects. The two meet, come to support each other in reintegrating into society and fall in love. There’s a problem, however: namely, the parasites in their heads.

105770.description: The second graphic novel by artist Aya Takano. One day, 13 year old Asto Uruta meets an enigmatic boy named Kibayashi. From that day on, and as if guided by fate, mysterious events start to happen around her, as she takes her first steps into a world that is vastly different from everyday life. Ancient civilizations, messiahs, underground worlds, visitors from outer space... Where do we come from? What are we? Where are we going? Artist Aya Takano merges and molds the familiar devices of science fiction, and in the process, creates a world that is entirely her own. Crossing 3000 years of time and space comes the story of a girl bearing her destiny.

105771.description: Aya Takano, a contemporary artist who fluidly eludes concrete classification of global art world melts in her saucepan everything from present/future, male/female to cruelty/utter sweetness spiced up with Japanese teenagers' arrogance into the “Jelly Civilization," a curiously antique Sci-Fi world 200 years from now. It's a super sustainable utopia where androgynous creatures live and love in a sweet decadence of subtle perversion without being hurt by anything - no square-ish gadgets or buildings Takano has always hated since childhood and everything is made of a jelly-like soft substance which will eventually dissolve into the soil.

105772.description: Location: London; time: near-future. John Watson, a depressed and unemployed man, receives an invitation to become a certain "unusual person's" flatmate. He soon finds out that this unusual person is an android named Sherlock Holmes.

105773.description: The manga is based on the second volume of Takeda Ayano's novel series Hibike! Euphonium.

title.romaji: Hibike! Euphonium: Kitauji Koukou Suisougaku-bu no Ichiban Atsui Natsu

105774.description:
Ichiri Sanjo, a middle school student raised in a typical household, lives under a persistent shadow of loneliness and suffocating restriction. One day, after school, while caught in the middle of a convenience store robbery, she is swept into a surreal experience—the very moment her journey of discovery and liberation ignites. Music, combat, dance, philosophy, and religion... Through the lens of Capoeira—a martial art encompassing every facet of human expression—visionary creator Toshio Sako pours his technical mastery into this extraordinary, coming-of-age violent epic. A genre-defying saga of youth begins.

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

The name says it all! Denji's life of poverty is changed forever when he merges with his pet chainsaw dog, Pochita! Now he's living in the big city and an official Devil Hunter. But he's got a lot to learn about his new job and chainsaw powers!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

105780.description:
Daigo Minai only has two goals—helping his sister pay off their late parents’ debt and graduating high school. But when he meets Arata One, a computer genius with an IQ of 191 and a penchant for punishing criminals, he gets saddled with a third—using his muscle to help One achieve his dream of one day ruling the city as the wizard-level hacker “ne0” by taking down one criminal at a time.

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Includes six extras chapters.

105781.description:
Higuma Kagarite is like any other high school student, except for one thing—his family has been charged by King Enma of hell himself to act as his Hell Wardens and return escaped evil souls to hell. He uses his Hell Warden abilities to save innocent humans who have been possessed by these fugitive spirits. One day, he meets Ayako, a girl at his school who keeps stealing things but can’t remember why. Ayako’s brother has recently become abusive toward her and her family. Higuma vows to save both her and her brother and to send the demons haunting them back to hell!

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Includes the one-shots 'Your Guardian', 'Higuma no Te', and an epilogue.

105782.description: Watch out, malevolent fugitive souls! Higuma will send you straight back to where you came from!

105783.description: Leo is left for dead after a robber stabs him with a knife and runs away. But, up until the very moment he passes out, he keeps a firm grasp on his desire to live. He wakes up in someone else’s bed, and he finds out that he was saved by Owen Bentley, a popular celebrity. He also finds out that Owen is a vampire—and that he had to turn Leo into a vampire in order to save him! But Owen harbors another secret, one that he seems to hide desperately… What is this secret? How will Leo find out?

105784.description:
It’s tough being in love, especially when you’re as fussy a girl as Karin towards her best friend Anzu.

Published in 12 separate parts on Nico Nico Seiga before collation into a doujinshi for COMITIA123 on 2018/2/11.

title.romaji: Mendoukusai Ko no Yuri no Ohanashi

105787.description: End of 1943. Shirakawa, a fighter pilot who fought in various parts of the world, finally returned to Tokyo. He has just been transferred to the Imperial Army Air Test Center. After a long absence, Shirakawa tries to resume his family life with his wife Mariko.

105789.description:
In an era where humanity, which once expanded its dominance to the stars, has long since lost its supremacy, scattered settlements around fully automated common bread production plants remain as the last bastions of human survival. Haruka travels through ruins to avoid the peering eyes of the ""Church,"" which advocates eating common bread over any other food.

(Source: Alpha Manga)

Note: Includes 2 bonus chapters

105790.description:
In everything he does, it seems like geeky Tokiwagi Middle School student Hajime Kano comes in second place behind popular honor student Emi Sawatari. But when Hajime takes a trip to a new game store he’s been hearing about, their rivalry takes an unexpected turn. Welcome to the early years of Magic: The Gathering, when a trading card game shaped a generation forever!

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Sixteenth place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category

105791.description:
Yoshida is just your average salaryman, drowning his tears in booze. On his way home one night, he finds a runaway high school girl sitting on the street. She offers to sleep with him in exchange for a place to stay―and Yoshida lets her off the hook and offers her work instead. A rom-com between the most unbalanced couple you'll ever find!

(Source: One Peace Books)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

105797.description:
The course of humanity has been completely changed by the appearance of the Sirens, a strange enemy that came from the sea. To counter the unknown enemy, mankind established a military alliance - "Azur Lane". The Sirens' invasion was halted, but not repelled. During the long standoff, differences surfaced between the factions, leading to conflict between them. In the midst of this battle, there is a military port that sits the furthest away from the battleground. There lives a beautiful silver-haired girl who belongs to the Royal faction and works as the chief maid. She is the second ship of the Edinburgh class, the Royal's largest cruiser, and her name is Belfast. Her slapstick daily life is about to begin!

105801.description:
Sawako Honna, 42, single; she works hard at a film promotion company. One night, all of a sudden, her heart palpitates, and her body goes cold... Could it be that she's going through menopause!?

Not as hard-working as in your 20s. Not as flippant as in your 30s. The mental and physical changes, and the obstacles you face in your 40s. Sudden illness, menopause, fatigue you can't get rid of, changes in working patterns, money worries, life plans for the future...

"What will happen to me tomorrow?"

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Notes:
- Winner of the Excellence Award in 23rd Japan Media Arts Festival.
- Nominated for the 2020 Manga Taisho Award.

105802.description:
Yume Hanayama is an ordinary school girl who longs for love. An ordinary school girl who love hair accessories making and chocolate chip cookies. Except for one thing, "I can not forgive liking anyone." After several years, Yume reunites with her childhood friend, Yukino, who supports her dream. Three people's past, secrets, twisted and and stagnated... a story about distorted love and  "a girl who can not like anyone."

(Source: Amazon, translated)

105808.description:
When the villainess Honey Trap defeats the superheroine Rapid Rabbit, she sees her nemesis’ face for the first time…and falls head over heels in love! Unable to kill Rapid Rabbit, Honey Trap is cast out of her evil organization, her plans for world domination dashed. Now, the two superwomen are teaming up to fight evil together. Can Honey Trap defeat her former colleagues and seduce the heroine at the same time?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

"I'll make sure you'll have a good time." 29-year-old virgin, Chiaki, housesits her uncle's big house. She enjoys her freedom living by herself for the first time, but a strange man shows up at the house suddenly claiming he also lives in the house. He turns out to be the president of the company where Chiaki works! He caresses her in the bathroom, during dinner, at the office, and melts her body...What do you mean this is a secret project of the company...?

(Source: Renta!)

105821.description:
Minkyu’s heart is pounding in his ears as he waits for Jung-yun, his dream girl, up on the roof of the school. Today, he got her number off the class contact list and finally mustered up the courage to text her. Now all he has to do is ask her out. Minkyu hears the door creak. Jung-yun’s here! Too embarrassed to look her in the eye, he blurts out his feelings for her and pops the question. “Okay,” a guy who is definitely not Jung-yun answers. Startled, Minkyu turns around to find Jung-hyun with an "h" blushing in front of him. Wait, wait, waaaait... Did he just ask out a dude? And did the dude just say yes? Does that mean he now has a 192 cm-tall, curtain-haired boyfriend? What the heck is going on?!

(Source: Lezhin)

105822.description:
Tooru and his sister Yume end up in the hospital after a traffic accident, leaving their father brain dead. Suddenly, Itou Yuuzen appears out of nowhere and takes them under his "religious cult's" protection. Is this the beginning of a new life for the brother and sister, or is something hiding behind the facade of this religious cult?

Note: Includes 9 extra chapters.

105823.description:
The story follows a girl where, after every week, the entire world forgets her. The result is a bittersweet and sentimental love story, where a boy and girl fall in love every week, only for him to forget all of his promises. Gold Prize winner of the 24th Dengeki Novel Prize.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

105829.description:
After a bitter divorce from a cheating husband in America, Matsubaki returns to Japan and goes straight from the airport to the remote, mountain estate of her sister’s husband, Michiyuki. Her sister is missing, and she hopes to find some clue as to her whereabouts, as well as connect with her niece Kazuno. There are ominous signs right from the very start; she has trouble finding her way around the walled estate to some kind of entrance and ends up going in the back way through the expansive garden where she runs into Takiri, Michiyuki’s adult son from his first marriage. He brings her inside where she meets his older sister, the family’s would-be matriarch Sagiri, whose sole concern in life is her young son, Nami. Naturally, everyone is creepy in a strange way, the house is enormous, there is a well-meaning butler who helps Matsusbaki but in the most ineffectual way until he is murdered, and a family history shrouded in mystery. Oh, and creepy murderous children spurred on by a ghost.

(Source: Brain Vs. Book)

105831.description:
Misaki has noticed that everyone in her town is a little crazy. From schizophrenic love notes to teddy bear abuse, this town is just plain weird. And in this town of whackos, Misaki is determined to convince the strange demon that only she can see that she is the last sane person in crazytown.

(Source: Mangamo)

Originally a human being, the samurai, who has been enshrined as a sacred spirit in this world, has managed "Omagatoki" by contract with Onmyoji and other teachers. Recently, however, a disturbing atmosphere has begun to drift ... The world of fellowship between humans and non-humans.

As soon as Kashiwagi though asked for the name of a certain classmate, he was surprised that the attitudes of his two newly made friends changed. In this high school students do not go against the absolutely "rules"! What will happen if he decides to disobey them?

Yatsusaki Yuudai, an enlightened high-schooler who lives by the motto "Live life in moderation".

It seems like the meeting of these two polar opposites will cause a huge disturbance in Yuudai's mundane school life!
It's a weird story of an Isekai club that establishes an alternate universe... ish!

105842.description:
Deep under the earth's surface dwells a beast that is only known to a select few. Currently docile, the beast is appeased by playing with the bodies of girls who indulge all its appendages. It's Eri's first day at her new job in the Chamber of the Demon Lord, and as she tags out one of her new co-workers, Maruka, the beast wraps them both up to see what this new girl is made of.

(Source: Fakku!)

105843.description:
It's been a month since Eri's first dive into the Chamber of the Demon Lord and she's gotten pretty used to her new life. She learns that whatever the beast is, it can take on any form—from primordial creatures to fat, middle-aged men. As their next mission starts, a building has formed, and while Eri makes her way into the structure, Maruka is taken away. Inside, the cold hands of a masked man in a cloak touch Eri's hot body. Is this the true form of the Demon Lord?

(Source: Fakku!)

After Eri's meeting with the Demon Lord, the cavern has become unstable! The miasma has taken on a new form that engulfs the entire facility, overtaking all that are exposed to this den of lust. Eri finally sees the true form of the beast and has to make a choice: return to the surface or stay with the Demon Lord for the rest of her life.

(Source: Fakku!)

105846.description:
Having sacrificed everything to land her position as the editor-in-chief of a fashion mag, Serena has every intention of taking advantage of the perks of her job - and that includes bossing around a younger cameraman under her! With his over-exaggerated reactions, Hal is an endless source of Serena's amusement - but such an abuse of power can only go on for so long until something gives!

(Source: Renta!)

105847.description:
I don't think of us as just childhood friends. "What do you do when you wake up half-naked... next to a childhood friend?! Himari's always yearned for a real true love, but she's always finding her efforts blocked because everyone thinks her childhood friend Aoto who's ALWAYS hanging around her is actually her boyfriend. One day, she wakes up after drinking WAY too much at a mixer while trying to find the boyfriend of her dreams... only to find herself in a hotel wearing only her underwear and lying next to a half-naked Aoto?! "Hold on a minute... Don't tell me Aoto and I... did it?!" He's so childish and unreliable, so for Himari to feel her heart race when seeing him as a man for the first time just seems... totally unexpected! Can childhood friends really fall in love...?

(Source: Renta!)

105848.description:
A scruffy-looking art teacher who everyone believes is absolutely still a virgin... is actually an extremely handsome guy with a sadistic streak?! He’s the only man who’s ever snuffed the advances of the truly devilish high school girl Ichika who thinks that all men are easy marks. His name is Mr. Hazama (or as Ichika calls him, the scrufflord). In a bout of pure anger, Ichika proclaims that she is going to make him fall for her, and she gleefully puts her plans in motion to make the target of her irritation love her. But... as she gets closer and sees him without his glasses on she finds out he’s actually handsome?! And then when she asks him why he’s disguising himself, Mr. Hazama shoves her onto the bed... and he starts acting like a completely different person?! Now that she knows his secret, Ichika finds herself falling for him...

(Source: GoodReads)

105849.description:

105850.description:
Outgoing college student Ikumi heads home for the summer, where he meets Harukiyo, a shy gardener with a soft spot for house plants. Despite seeming totally resistant to Ikumi's charms, Harukiyo eventually admits his attraction to Ikumi, and Ikumi is surprised to discover he feels the same way about Harukyo! At summer's end, the pair embark on their first long-distance relationship... Once reunited, Ikumi and Harukiyo stumble together through the early stages of their newfound romance, tripping over the stark differences in their personalities. Can a blossoming love between a shining star and a prickly hedgehog go the distance?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

105851.description: In the urban civilization floating in space, "Cocoon", lived four students of the United Nations University: Arata, Tara, Caesar, and Louis. These four were a new breed of human, who had undergone the process of neoteny and adapted to the space age. The entirety of human relationships are decided by contracts, and while some humans get to live for hundreds of years, others are not quite so lucky. One day, these four meet a girl with green hair in the red light district, and thus our story begins.

Maika and Aoi decide to sneak out on a lovey-dovey getaway together for some much-needed R&R, but their plans end up wrecked by sudden inclement weather. They rush into their quaint private cabin to dry off, but Aoi might end up getting soaked one way or the other...

105853.description:
Ever since Kaga's elder brother left home, he has been pushing himself to keep his parents happy - and meet his parents' expectations. Always pretending to be the perfect student tires him out and he vents his frustration when alone. One day while venting in the boy's restroom, he didn't know Saotome saw this and took a video. Saotome later confronts Kaga about knowing his "secret". But what is Saotome really after?

(Source: Eiz)

Katou swore that he wouldn’t lay a hand on Serizawa until he liked him back, so he kept their relationship platonic. Serizawa suddenly comes to stay over at his house, inviting him for a kiss, and testing Katou’s control. Seeing Serizawa showing such an erotic expression, Katou just can’t hold back anymore!!!

105856.description:
A wealthy man, Kurosu Tokimune, meets an unnatural end. With his death, his family joins together to grieve, only to become suspects of a police investigation as to whether he was murdered.

Their primary suspect: the adopted daughter of the Kurosu family and first to discover his body, Kurosu Tokiko. The girl who shows no distress at her father's death. And as all suspicions point to her, the second unnatural death occurs...

It's always been this way. Wherever Tokiko goes, people tend to die.

105862.description:
Hae-Soo is a cynical writer of a romance column, while Joo-Won, his former stepbrother, is a famous actor. The two go way back - thrust together when their parents remarried, their relationship is far from simple. Brothers? Soulmates? Friends with benefits? Or nothing at all? Theirs is a delicate balance between lust and loathing, dating and breaking up, irritation and infatuation.

When the mysterious photographer “K” takes an interest in Hae-Soo, events begin to spiral out of control. As the lines between art and reality become increasingly blurred, what direction will this story take? Cheap romance? Sensual erotica? Or something much more twisted?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Wolf-kun and Usagi-chan are a couple who belong to very different races. A problem arose within Wolf-kun & Usagi-chan’s relationship…Wolf-kun couldn’t make Usagi-chan cum. The only answer that Wolf-kun could think of was… “What if you embraced me instead?”

Three days after his sister's death, he finally regained the will to move. In the aftermath of a goblin raid, a lone boy mourns the loss of his village, his family...Five years later, that same boy visits a city on the frontier and becomes an adventurer.Despite being the lowest rank and wholly inexperienced, the young adventurer immediately accepts a quest and sets out alone to raid a goblin lair. His mind already burning with a clear vision of his calling, the legend of Goblin Slayer begins!

(Source: Yen Press)

105866.description:
LJO–aka Law of Justice Online–is the newest full-dive VRMMORPG to hit the market, and office worker Yuta—or Yuto, as he goes by in the game—is ready to spend his whole vacation immersing himself in the experience. His dream is to become the strongest Tamer, commanding the most powerful monsters, and he's even willing to shell out the cash to do so! But when he arrives in the world of LJO for the first time, Yuto is shocked to find that the special monster he planned to leave all the fighting to is...a monster dedicated to farming—without a shred of combat ability?

Despite it all, Yuto quickly decides that his adventures in this world will involve way less fighting epic battles and way more harvesting plants, as he prepares to take the game at his own pace and with his adorable, trusty companion by his side!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

105867.description:
The Law of Justice Online, also known as LJO, is the hottest new VRMMORPG of the season, and office worker Yuta Sasaki is one of the lucky few granted access to the official launch. After some careful research, Yuta is chomping at the bit to start his virtual life as a Tamer, a class that harnesses the powers of wild monsters. Luckily, upon building his character, Yuta manages to land not only his chosen class, but a heap of bonuses to boot! He soon finds, however, that his abilities are not all they're cracked up to be, and that the talents of the rare first monster he is granted lie not in combat...but gardening! Already well behind the other adventurers, and facing a long and slow progression path ahead of him, Yuta is left with two choices—start over from scratch, or make the best of what he has been given. For Yuta the choice is obvious: When life gives you manure...start up a farm!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

The hit novel is now a comic! Alto, a novice librarian, is cursed to turn into a woman at sundown. To turn back into a man, he has to sleep with other men! Alto confesses his problem to the handsome bad-boy knight Sir Lloyd, who's only too happy to help him out. Alto shouldn't be enjoying this, but why does it feel so good!? And then there's Sir Lune, the well-mannered knight-in-shining-armor Alto has always admired, who's worried about Alto, too... Enjoy this one-of-a-kind story! Kouta is an ordinary college student who grows flowers and vegetables on his veranda. One day, he found a good-looking guy had sprouted in his planter!! He calls himself Flower, and just asks for water... Kouta doesn't believe it, but he can't just leave him, so he decides to take care of his "Flower."
